label_policy.positive: VULNERABLE + target memorybounds error + verification_finished yes; no contradictory NON-VULNERABLE
label_policy.negative: NON-VULNERABLE + verification_finished yes; no vulnerable/unfinished/category-conflict program record
label_policy.unknown: all other records, including only-unfinished vulnerability reports, receive no binary target label
label_policy.negative_scope: dataset reported non-vulnerable outcome, not proved unbounded C safety

exact: dereference failure: Access to object out of bounds

structural_profile: single-main-local; exactly one ordinary main function definition; no interprocedural or indirect calls; original context rules retained
input_semantics_profile: format-sensitive memory I/O rejected symmetrically; original sizeof/unit unknown retained only with original type/operand tokens and complete context
memory_task_gate: label-independent syntactic subscript/pointer access or explicitly enumerated memory API; no memory use is task_not_applicable
readout: whole-program all-original-candidate max; complete nonempty accepted inventory required
near_clone_and_prompt_family: unverified beyond supplied official clone filtering; no claim of semantic independence
